sys_script.description: Enforces the receipt requirement on the insert-as-submitted path, which Validate Claim (order 200) deliberately skips. Returns a receiptless claim to draft and cancels any approvals already requested.
sys_script.name: ClaimEase - Enforce Receipt On Submitted

sys_script.description: Returns a claim to submitted when its receipt arrives after the async receipt-enforcement rule had already sent it back to draft.
sys_script.name: ClaimEase - Restore Claim On Receipt
